    for i, ((x, y, z), (vx, vy, vz), mass) in enumerate(bodies):

        for j in range(i + 1, len(bodies)):
            (xj, yj, zj), _, other_mass = bodies[j]
            dx = x - xj

        lines.extend([
            f"        x{i} += dt * vx{i}",
            f"        y{i} += dt * vy{i}",
            f"        z{i} += dt * vz{i}",
        ])

    for i in range(5):
        lines.extend([
            f"    bodies[{i}][0][:] = x{i}, y{i}, z{i}",
            f"    bodies[{i}][1][:] = vx{i}, vy{i}, vz{i}",
        ])

    namespace = {}
    exec(compile("\n".join(lines), "<nbody_kernel>", "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace["advance"]


def main():
    n = int(sys.argv[1])
    bodies = make_bodies()
    offset_momentum(bodies)
    advance = build_integrator()

    initial = energy(bodies)
    advance(n, bodies)
    final = energy(bodies)
    sys.stdout.write(f"{initial:.9f}\n{final:.9f}\n")
